WhyArtaveo.description: Artaveo is not a team with layers of handoffs. One person carries each project from idea to deployment, keeping the architecture, interface and code on one path.

StartPage.title: Let’s scope your project
StartPage.description: A short, structured brief. A few minutes now means less back-and-forth later. Answer what you know and skip the rest.

BriefBuilder.serviceStepDescription: Pick the closest match — it helps me prepare and doesn’t lock you in.
BriefBuilder.engagementModelLabel: How would you like to work together?
BriefBuilder.goalLabel: What outcome are you trying to reach?
BriefBuilder.goalPlaceholder: Describe the problem or goal in a few sentences…
BriefBuilder.goalHint: A few sentences is enough — the call is where we go deeper.
BriefBuilder.scopeStepTitle: What does it need to do?
BriefBuilder.scopeStepDescription: Check anything that applies. It's fine to leave this empty if you're not sure yet.
BriefBuilder.budgetHint: A rough range is enough — it helps me suggest the right engagement model, not a fixed price.
BriefBuilder.linksStepDescription: A current site, a competitor, a design reference — anything that helps me understand the project. Optional.
BriefBuilder.phoneHint: Only needed if WhatsApp is your preferred channel.
BriefBuilder.consentLabel: I agree that Artaveo may contact me about this project using the details above.
BriefBuilder.reviewStepDescription: Here’s your brief so far. Go back to change anything before sending.
BriefBuilder.errorTooShort: A little more detail would help — a few sentences is enough.
BriefBuilder.errorInvalidUrl: Enter a full URL, starting with https://
BriefBuilder.notLiveDescription: The Brief Builder's backend is built but not yet connected to a live database (roadmap Phase 9.2, pending the Supabase project setup) — nothing was lost, but it wasn't saved on this site either. Send it by email instead and I'll reply directly; your answers above are already in the message.
BriefBuilder.genericErrorDescription: Your brief wasn't saved due to an unexpected error. Nothing was lost — send it by email instead and I'll reply directly; your answers above are already in the message.
BriefBuilder.successDescription: Thanks — I'll reply with next steps.
BriefBuilder.offlineQueuedDescription: Your brief is saved on this device and will send automatically the moment you're back online — you don't need to do anything else. You can also go back and keep editing while you wait.
BriefBuilder.successQueuedNote: You were offline when you first tried to send this — good news, it went through as soon as you reconnected.
BriefBuilder.attachmentsDescription: Screenshots, mockups, or anything else that helps explain what you're picturing.
BriefBuilder.attachmentInvalidType: That file type isn't allowed — use PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, or SVG.
BriefBuilder.attachmentTooLarge: That file is over the 5 MB limit.
BriefBuilder.attachmentRejected: Too many uploads from this connection recently — try again in a bit.
BriefBuilder.attachmentsRules: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, or SVG, up to 5 MB each, up to 3 files.

Admin.cmsArticleWarnUnsafeLink: A link with an unsupported address was shown as plain text.
Admin.cmsArticleWarnUnsupportedImage: An image that is not from the media library was shown as text.
Admin.cmsArticleFormatHelpIntro: The body is plain text with a small Markdown subset. Anything else — including HTML — is shown as plain text.
Admin.cmsArticleImagePick: Choose an image from the media library
Admin.cmsArticleImageNone: The media library is empty — upload an image there first.
Admin.cmsArticleImageNote: Adds the image reference at the end of the body; move the line to where it belongs. Alt text comes from the media library.
Admin.cmsArticleRelatedNote: Only published items are shown on the public article.
Admin.cmsErrorHasPlaceholder: A bracketed placeholder such as [CLIENT_NAME] is still in the text — replace it before publishing.
Admin.cmsErrorMissingImage: The body embeds an image that is no longer in the media library.
Admin.cmsErrorInvalidSchedule: Pick a real go-live date, today or later.
Admin.cmsErrorSaveFailed: Something went wrong while saving. Save again — if the text was already stored, this retries the project/service/article links.
Admin.notifIntro: Every e-mail the site produces is saved here before it is sent, so a provider outage never loses one. Failed messages are retried with growing delays; the ones that keep failing wait here for you.
Admin.notifNotConfigured: The notification log is not configured yet — no database connection is set up.
Admin.notifProviderConsoleOff: Real sending is off. Messages are recorded as “sent” by the console provider, but nothing leaves the server until a real provider is set up.
Admin.notifProviderMisconfigured: EMAIL_PROVIDER is set to “{requested}”, but the provider is not fully configured, so nothing is being delivered. Check RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS.
Admin.notifCronSecretMissing: CRON_SECRET is not set in this deployment, so the daily run — retries and scheduled publishing — is refused. Add it in the Vercel project settings and redeploy.
Admin.notifUncoveredInquiries: {count, plural, one {# inquiry from the last 7 days has} other {# inquiries from the last 7 days have}} no notification record. The inquiry itself is saved.
Admin.notifExhaustedBanner: {count, plural, one {# message failed for good and needs you.} other {# messages failed for good and need you.}}
Admin.notifOverdue: {count, plural, one {# message is} other {# messages are}} due and waiting for a sweep — the oldest since {date}.
Admin.notifNoOverdue: Nothing is waiting: every message that is due has been attempted.
Admin.notifEmptyDescription: Clear a filter, or come back after the next inquiry or submission.
Admin.notifRetryResultFailed: Still failing — it will be tried again later. See the error on the message.
Admin.notifRetryResultExhausted: Failed again and stopped. See the error on the message.
Admin.notifErrorNotRetryable: This message can’t be retried in its current state.
Admin.notifDetailExhausted: This message failed for good and will not be retried on its own. Fix the cause shown below, then press Retry now.
Admin.notifNotDeliveredNote: The console provider only logged this message — no e-mail was sent.
Admin.notifAttemptsEmpty: No attempt has been made yet.
Admin.cmsRecRequestEmailNote: With an address, the site e-mails them this link — and, if you later ask for a change, that request too. The address is deleted as soon as the request is finished (revoked, approved, rejected, or expired unused).
Admin.cmsRecEmailInvalid: That e-mail address doesn’t look valid. Fix it, or leave it empty and share the link yourself.
Admin.cmsRecEmailQueued: Link created and queued for e-mail. Check the state below.
Admin.cmsRecEmailQueueFailed: Link created, but the e-mail could not be queued. Copy the link and send it yourself.
Admin.cmsRecEmailNotQueued: e-mail was not queued — copy the link
